stages.label: Story — play Chapters 1–5
stages.note: Finish the five-chapter main story (about 60–80 hours). Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation with Lucia when it appears (Positive Mental Attitude) and scan vehicles and study animals as you go.

stages.label: 100% checklist, collectibles & challenges
stages.note: After the credits, work the 100% Completion checklist under Progress > Stats. It is roughly 60% of the game and nothing in it is missable: 70 of 80 challenges, 42 shooting-range golds, 300 stunts, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, every robbery, 15 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans and 33 underwater discoveries. About 100 hours.

stages.label: Character strands, Strangers & Freaks & cleanup
stages.note: Finish Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret's questlines, complete 8 Stranger & Freaks strands, and mop up any remaining misc trophies. About 10 hours.

stages.label: Platinum
stages.note: Vice Got a Price! pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. The entire list is single-player only: there are no online trophies, no DLC and no difficulty gates, so one playthrough plus cleanup is enough. PowerPyx's roadmap counts zero online trophies and puts the whole list at one minimum playthrough.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic and unmissable: it unlocks right after the very first main mission of Chapter 1, the fishing trip Gone Fishing. There is nothing to do but follow the on-screen story beats. PowerPyx lists it as the game's opening mission.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Automatic and unmissable. The trophy pops once Chapter 1 is finished, as Chapter 2's first mission (What's in the Bag?) gets under way, so you will not miss it as long as you keep playing the story. PowerPyx notes chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the closing cutscene.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Automatic and unmissable: finishing Chapter 2 earns it as Chapter 3 (Welcome to Vice City) begins. Just keep progressing the main missions. PowerPyx confirms it cannot be missed.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Automatic and unmissable. It unlocks once Chapter 3 is done, around the first two missions of Chapter 4 (Ocean Beach and Another Life). No special play is required.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Automatic and unmissable: finish Chapter 4 and this pops as the story rolls into its final chapter. PowerPyx ties it to the last main mission of Chapter 4, Starting From Zero.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Automatic and unmissable. It unlocks when you complete the game's final story mission, which closes the fifth and last chapter. Because there is no mission replay and no difficulty option, simply playing to the end of the story guarantees it.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Automatic and unmissable: it unlocks during the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. There is nothing to seek out; the mission is on the critical path.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Automatic and unmissable: finish the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist and the trophy lands. It is a mandatory story mission.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Automatic and unmissable: complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play (rescuing Rafa) and it unlocks. No optional conditions are involved.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Automatic and unmissable: finish the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. It is on the story's critical path, so it cannot be skipped.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Automatic and unmissable: complete the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown. Just play the story and it will pop on its own.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Automatic and unmissable: finish the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. PowerPyx places it in the final chapter, so it comes naturally as the story winds down.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The big one. After the story you unlock the 100% Completion checklist under Progress > Stats, and progress made during the story already counts. It is far from true 100% — roughly 60% of the game — and nothing toward it is missable. The main asks are 70 of 80 challenges, 42 shooting-range gold medals, 300 stunts, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned and 100 of 255 animals studied, plus all robberies, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans and 33 underwater discoveries.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps, freely mixed. Under-the-bridge flights are the fastest. The 100% checklist wants 300 stunts, so this lands on the way there.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The tracker counts 9 activity types — fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race or drone race, and a stunt — and you only need to do each once. Most arrive automatically through the story and the other trophies, so it is effectively free.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold-medal all 42 shooting range challenges, spread across 12 ranges. Every one of the 42 is also required for the 100% checklist, so chasing A Long Road clears this too.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: There are 14 Top Fun locations with 42 drone races in total; win at least one race at each of the 14 locations. The drone time trials also feed the 100% checklist.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win any 20 of the 40 unique races. The 100% checklist wants 30 race wins and 10 of 13 race-challenge gold medals, so keep racing after this pops.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After meeting Cal in Chapter 1 (the Feng Shui mission) he texts you a fishing spot, which starts his fishing questline. Follow that line through to the challenge and beat him at it. The whole thing stays available after the story.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish all levels of any one of the 4 arcade games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the home TV from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck sits on arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end of one game.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's five-quest line, which is exclusive to Lucia and gets marked automatically in Chapter 3 (Belville). The quests are Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. It stays available after the story and does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving questline: after the Chapter 1 mission Island Dreams he marks shipwreck sets for you, and in total he wants 7 cleared. He goes quiet for a stretch mid-story but always returns, so this is not missable — his treasures also feed the 100% checklist.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's five-quest line at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County, marked automatically after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. The quests are Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. It is available after the story and does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Only certain open-world questlines count as "strangers" for this trophy. PowerPyx confirms Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete's strands qualify, while named optional lines like Moses, Tyrone, Andy and Billy do not. Everything needed is still in the world after the story, so it is not missable.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List: after Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS he asks for 16 specific sports cars, which you can steal from the street or from the fixed spots he marks (green RK icon, west Vice City). The deliveries also pay toward the $200,000 vehicles-fenced goal for 100%.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's line is Jason-only and marked after Chapter 3's Here, Kitty Kitty. Destroy the Synthetic Labs across Vice City (the Take Out Kitty Litter quest), then complete his follow-up Spin On This. It all remains available after the story.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: Missable only in Chapter 1: after the mission Down to Earth, follow Lucia to the balcony at Jason's house and accept the meditation — it raises the counter but is not a marked spot, and it cannot be redone after Chapter 1.
trophies.guide: There are 18 Meditation Spots across 10 locations, and meditating at a spot as both Jason and Lucia counts double. The one possible miss is the unmarked Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house: the morning after Down to Earth, Lucia says she is going to meditate and walks to the balcony, so follow her and accept. PowerPyx flags that first meditation as potentially required and still unconfirmed, so do it when it appears; the 100% checklist itself only needs 15 of 18.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Progress Bret Vogel's hunting questline, which is Jason-only and marked after Chapter 2's Coffee Break in Lummox County. His 15 Target Decks are all required for the 100% checklist, so the trophy lands on the way there.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets (480 cards in total across them). The 100% checklist wants 15 complete sets, so chasing A Long Road will take you well past this.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK objects with the phone app — landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and more. Far more than 100 exist and the 100% checklist asks for exactly these 100 scans, so any 100 you find will do.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so save this for late and pick the easiest remaining ones; most complete passively while you work on everything else.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: From Chapter 2's Coffee Break you can free-roam as both characters together. Reach a 4-star wanted level with your partner along, then escape the red heat zone — the train tunnel north of Ambrosia is a reliable route. The bank-vault robberies later hand you 4-star escapes automatically if you still lack it.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner called in, rob 3 shops in a row while the wanted level never drops. The three jewelry stores in north Vice City work well, and the unlock can lag about 30 seconds after the third shop — hit a fourth if it has not popped.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Scan 100 different vehicles with the WAiNK app — scanning is enough, you do not need to drive them. The game has 557 vehicles, and the 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning everything new you see.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus (L3+R3 while aiming), then take down 5 enemies before it runs out. Buff your focus first, pop Adrenaline to extend the window, and line up five criminals at a gang operation with an assault rifle; it does not seem to count on police, soldiers or civilians.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal (the E3/E4 gate is the easiest) and fly it about 1 km away from the airport — the unlock is delayed, so keep flying until it pops.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station on the island at the south-west edge of the map, then shoot enemies until the trophy unlocks.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: After Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs you get the Snap Gun, which silently lockpicks alarmed back doors. Enter a jewelry store through the back, find the note with the safe code, and clean out the safe without triggering the alarm.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape. Vaults unlock through the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, and the 100% checklist wants all 8, so this pops on the way there.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the heat. Block one in traffic and blow its rear doors with a sticky bomb, or simply do your first bank-vault robbery, which counts automatically.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the entire map. It is fastest in a plane, sweeping the blacked-out regions until nothing is hidden.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: There are 9 gangs and 39 illegal operations; rob at least one operation belonging to each gang. All 39 are required for the 100% checklist, so this lands on the way there.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: The description is all the sources print so far, so the exact trigger is not yet confirmed anywhere. Head to a bar with a view along Ocean Beach and order a drink — the method will firm up as sources verify it.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The sources print only the description for now, so the precise method is unconfirmed. The intent is clearly a showroom smash-and-grab: drive a car straight out through the glass in the series' classic fashion.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: At the Kingpin Bowling gang operation in Port Gellhorn (reached through Chapter 2's optional Hit Kingpin Bowling), steal all three key valuables — the luxury watch, the unique shotgun and the office safe — then escape. Not missable: the operation respawns if you miss one.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Work out together at fitness clubs: while you train one character, the partner trains alongside, so both progress at once.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that move your criminal profile — robberies, clean escapes, takedowns and more all count, and it builds passively as you play. Turn on criminal-profile notifications under Settings > UI to watch the counter move.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The method is not yet confirmed. PowerPyx believes it involves the Payday Loans store from the Prologue and labels that belief unconfirmed, so treat any specific step as tentative until a source verifies it.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The method is not yet confirmed. PowerPyx believes it comes from a UFO questline and marks that belief unconfirmed, so watch for anything strange in the sky and treat specifics as tentative.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The method is not yet confirmed. PowerPyx believes it involves knocking enemies down while riding a motorcycle and marks that belief unconfirmed, so treat any specific step as tentative.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your fences. It needs the Dye Pack Jammer from Chapter 3's Credit Check, and large bank vaults pay up to $205,000 each, so this comes naturally while you rob banks for the checklist.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across every kind of shop. Guns, car modifications and tattoos burn through the money fastest.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages — about $160,000 in total — through the Vice City Real Estate phone app, available from Chapter 2. The 4 story garages do not count.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app arrives with Chapter 2's Moses mission. Drive 10 stolen vehicles to his garage in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray then Register; each takes a parking spot, so buy garages first, and use cheap cars and bikes since registration costs money. Tracker-fitted cars are only accepted from Chapter 3.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5) trophies
